en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a quiet, unpaved street in a small town. Wooden buildings line both sides of the street, with visible power or telephone lines and trees in the background. The building on the left features a hanging sign reading 'A.R. Törnqvist.' The top left corner of the postcard has the red-printed word 'Lovisa,' likely indicating the town's name.
